scope_deviations.item: Reviewer model division (Fable primary, GPT-5.6 Sol second review)
scope_deviations.reason: This session executes as a single configured model and cannot invoke Claude Fable or GPT-5.6 Sol. All findings below are from direct database execution, not model opinion. Independent second review remains outstanding.

The preview branch was created with_data=false and carries only v7_worker. The result bridge's write target, dcse_cp.agent_task_events, does not exist in the preview. The bridge's end-to-end path was therefore NOT exercised in this environment.

rollback_script_placement_note: Deliberately stored OUTSIDE supabase/migrations/. The Supabase GitHub integration applies every file in the migrations directory, so a rollback script kept there would be executed on the next push and would silently strip the hardening.

migration_version_reconciliation.issue: The Supabase Preview check failed twice with 'Remote migration versions not found in local migrations directory.'
migration_version_reconciliation.first_cause: The two hardening migrations were applied through the Supabase MCP apply_migration tool, which assigned remote versions 20260727231155 and 20260727231413, while the local files were named 20260729_*. Renaming them fixed that half of the mismatch but the check still failed.
migration_version_reconciliation.actual_root_cause: Two pre-existing repository migrations used 8-digit version prefixes (20260727_v7_result_bridge_and_dispatcher.sql and 20260728_v7_agent_worker_communication_system.sql). The Supabase CLI only recognises 14-digit YYYYMMDDHHMMSS versions, so it did not see those two files locally and reported their remote rows as missing. This defect predates the RLS work.
migration_version_reconciliation.resolution: Both files were renamed to the 14-digit versions production already uses for the same migrations (20260727223056 and 20260727223121), and the preview's schema_migrations rows were repaired to match. All five tracked versions are now 14-digit and map 1:1 to a local file.

defects_found_and_repaired.title: claim_next_task ambiguous column reference "task_id"
defects_found_and_repaired.detail: The subquery counting prior attempts referenced task_id unqualified. Every claim attempt raised 42702, so lane and task-type authorization never executed. Production had been hot-patched in place; the repo migration still carried the defect.
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: Qualified as tc2.task_id inside the counting subquery.

defects_found_and_repaired.title: send_heartbeat accepted suspended and retired workers
defects_found_and_repaired.detail: The function checked only that the agent row existed, never its status. A suspended worker could continue reporting liveness, defeating the dispatcher's stale-worker suspension.

defects_found_and_repaired.title: result_submission.claim_id had no foreign key
defects_found_and_repaired.detail: Submissions referencing entirely non-existent claims were accepted.
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: Added FK result_submission_claim_id_fkey referencing task_claim(claim_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT.

defects_found_and_repaired.title: No active-lease enforcement on submission
defects_found_and_repaired.detail: A worker could submit a result against a released or expired lease, so crash-recovery could produce two authoritative results for one task.
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: BEFORE INSERT trigger enforce_active_lease validates claim existence, agent ownership, non-release, and unexpired visibility timeout.

defects_found_and_repaired.title: No idempotency constraint on result_submission
defects_found_and_repaired.detail: Identical (claim_id, result_event_type) rows were accepted repeatedly. The previously reported duplicate-suppression guarantee did not exist at the database level.

defects_found_and_repaired.title: No cross-worker claim mutation guard
defects_found_and_repaired.detail: Any holder of the service_role key could release or rewrite another worker's claim. RLS did not apply because service_role bypasses it.
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: BEFORE UPDATE trigger guard_claim_mutation: ownership immutable; mutation permitted only in dispatcher context or by the owning session agent.

defects_found_and_repaired.title: Dispatcher recovery window permanently orphaned stale claims
defects_found_and_repaired.detail: Phase 1 required (now() - visibility_timeout_at) < interval '5 minutes'. Any claim expired for longer than five minutes was never recovered, so a worker crash outside one dispatcher cycle stranded the task forever.
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: Removed the upper bound; all expired unreleased leases are now recovered.

defects_found_and_repaired.title: SECURITY DEFINER functions carried mutable search_path
defects_found_and_repaired.detail: All ten privileged functions ran with search_path = 'public, v7_worker'. A writable public schema makes this a privilege-escalation surface.
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: All ten functions set search_path = '' with fully schema-qualified relations. Verified: 0 SECURITY DEFINER functions remain with a mutable path.

defects_found_and_repaired.title: EXECUTE on privileged RPCs granted to PUBLIC
defects_found_and_repaired.detail: All seven v7_worker functions carried the PUBLIC grant (=X/postgres); claim_next_task, send_heartbeat and release_task_claim were additionally granted to anon and authenticated. Exploitation was blocked only by the absence of USAGE on schema v7_worker, a single point of failure that would fall the moment the schema were exposed to the API.
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: Revoked from PUBLIC, anon and authenticated on all ten functions; EXECUTE granted to service_role only; USAGE on v7_worker revoked from PUBLIC/anon/authenticated.

defects_found_and_repaired.title: PS lane had no explicit hard denial
defects_found_and_repaired.detail: PS exclusion relied solely on an array-membership match, with no independent guard.
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: Added an explicit predicate: a PS message is served only when 'PS' is present in the agent's authorized_lanes.

defects_found_and_repaired.title: Migration filenames encoded the wrong dependency order
defects_found_and_repaired.detail: v7_result_bridge_and_dispatcher was numbered 20260727 and v7_agent_worker_communication_system was numbered 20260728, so the bridge migration sorted BEFORE the migration that creates the v7_worker schema it depends on. Any fresh deployment applying migrations in filename order would have failed. Both environments survived only because the two migrations were hand-applied out of filename order. The 8-digit prefixes also made the Supabase CLI unable to see the files at all, which is what broke the Preview check.
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: Renamed to the 14-digit versions production already records for the same migrations: 20260727223056 (schema) then 20260727223121 (bridge), restoring correct dependency order, and repaired the preview's schema_migrations rows to match.

defects_found_and_repaired.title: Production hot-fixes were never captured in migrations
defects_found_and_repaired.detail: Both the dc_event_id BIGINT to TEXT change and the claim_next_task ambiguity fix were applied directly to production and never written into a migration. Preview still had dc_event_id as bigint. Any fresh deployment from the repository would have reintroduced both defects.
defects_found_and_repaired.repair: Captured in migration: dc_event_id altered to text, acknowledge_result_processed re-created with a text parameter, and the claim_next_task fix committed.

outstanding_findings_not_repaired.title: Worker identity is caller-asserted, not authenticated
outstanding_findings_not_repaired.detail: claim_next_task, send_heartbeat and release_task_claim all take agent_id as a parameter and never bind it to an authenticated principal. Any caller reaching these functions can act as any agent. The RLS policies use current_setting('app.worker_id'), a client-settable GUC, which is equally unauthenticated. Workers additionally hold the service_role key, which bypasses RLS entirely, so the per-worker policies on all eight tables are currently unreachable code.
outstanding_findings_not_repaired.current_mitigation: EXECUTE is now service_role-only, USAGE on v7_worker is revoked from the API roles, and the lease/ownership/idempotency invariants are enforced by constraints and triggers that bind service_role as well. The matrix passes on that basis.
outstanding_findings_not_repaired.required_fix: Issue per-worker JWTs carrying an agent_id claim, have v7_worker_private.session_agent_id() read only the verified claim, remove the app.worker_id fallback, and stop distributing the service_role key to workers.
outstanding_findings_not_repaired.recommended_gate: Treat as a Stop-Gate before production worker rollout. It does not block the preview certification, which is scoped to the role matrix.

outstanding_findings_not_repaired.title: Result bridge path unexercised in preview
outstanding_findings_not_repaired.detail: dcse_cp does not exist in the preview branch, so the v7_worker to dcse_cp.agent_task_events write path could not be tested here. The earlier end-to-end cycle timing was measured against production, not this preview.
outstanding_findings_not_repaired.required_fix: Re-run the bridge cycle in an environment that carries both schemas before convergence.

outstanding_findings_not_repaired.title: Advisor findings outside v7_worker
outstanding_findings_not_repaired.detail: Supabase security advisors returned nine INFO-level rls_enabled_no_policy lints, all against family_vow_go tables (admin_feedback, budget_items, content_chapters, external_integrations, guests, music_items, vendors, wedding_events, wedding_settings). Zero findings against v7_worker or v7_worker_private.
outstanding_findings_not_repaired.required_fix: Out of scope for this certification; flagged because those tables have RLS enabled with no policies.
